<!--
Template shipped with the zfbehavior package (inst/skills/behavior-endpoints-anova/).
Do not edit the analysis code below for a specific study -- put every
study-specific choice in behavior-endpoints-anova.yml and render with:

  quarto render behavior-endpoints-anova.qmd --execute-params behavior-endpoints-anova.yml

This document only calls exported zfbehavior functions. See
inst/skills/CONVENTIONS.md for the run-folder / naming / manifest rules.
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(zfbehavior)

p <- params
skill <- "behavior-endpoints-anova"

stop_param <- function(msg) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints-anova parameter error: ", msg, call. = FALSE)
}
as_chr <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) character(0) else unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
or_default <- function(x, default) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) default else x
num <- function(x, default, what, lower = -Inf, upper = Inf, integer = FALSE) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(or_default(x, default)))
  if (length(v) != 1 || !is.finite(v) || v < lower || v > upper || (integer && v != round(v))) {
    stop_param(paste0("`", what, "` must be ", if (integer) "an integer" else "a number",
                      " in [", lower, ", ", upper, "]."))
  }
  v
}

if (is.null(p$run_label) || !grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", p$run_label)) {
  stop_param("`run_label` is required (letters, digits, '-', '_').")
}
upstream_runs <- sub("/+$", "", as_chr(p$upstream))
if (length(upstream_runs) == 0) {
  stop_param("`upstream` must list one behavior-endpoints run (plus optional intraplate-vc-qc runs).")
}
similarity_metrics <- or_default(as_chr(p$similarity_metrics), "spearman")
bad_metric <- setdiff(similarity_metrics, c("spearman", "pearson"))
if (length(bad_metric) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`similarity_metrics` must be spearman and/or pearson (correlations, Fisher z); got: ",
                    paste(bad_metric, collapse = ", ")))
}
alpha <- num(p$alpha, 0.05, "alpha", lower = 1e-12, upper = 0.5)
rmanova_mode <- as.character(or_default(p$rmanova, "auto"))
if (!rmanova_mode %in% c("auto", "FALSE", "false")) stop_param("`rmanova` must be auto or false.")
rmanova_mode <- if (rmanova_mode == "auto") "auto" else "off"
seed <- num(p$seed, 20260806, "seed", lower = 0, integer = TRUE)
chemical_label_cols <- or_default(as_chr(p$chemical_label_cols), "CHEMICAL_NAME")
plate_label_cols <- or_default(as_chr(p$plate_label_cols), "plate_id")
n_per_page <- num(p$n_per_page, 20, "n_per_page", lower = 1, integer = TRUE)
plot_order <- or_default(p$order, "alphabetical")
if (!plot_order %in% c("alphabetical", "as_given")) stop_param("`order` must be alphabetical or as_given.")
pdf_width <- num(p$pdf_width, 17, "pdf_width", lower = 1)
pdf_height <- num(p$pdf_height, 16, "pdf_height", lower = 1)
chemical_wrap_width <- num(p$chemical_wrap_width, 50, "chemical_wrap_width", lower = 5, integer = TRUE)
activity_exclude_tests <- as_chr(p$activity_exclude_tests)
bad_tests <- setdiff(activity_exclude_tests, c("ANOVA", "RMANOVA"))
if (length(bad_tests) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`activity_exclude_tests` must be ANOVA and/or RMANOVA; got: ", paste(bad_tests, collapse = ", ")))
}
activity_exclude_endpoints <- as_chr(p$activity_exclude_endpoints)
activity_exclude_reason <- or_default(p$activity_exclude_reason, NULL)
if (!is.null(activity_exclude_reason) && !nzchar(trimws(as.character(activity_exclude_reason)))) {
  activity_exclude_reason <- NULL
}
if ((length(activity_exclude_tests) > 0 || length(activity_exclude_endpoints) > 0) && is.null(activity_exclude_reason)) {
  stop_param("`activity_exclude_reason` is required when `activity_exclude_tests` or `activity_exclude_endpoints` is not empty.")
}

project_root <- normalizePath(p$project_root, mustWork = TRUE)
out_dir <- "outputs"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_path <- function(object, ext) {
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(skill, "__", p$run_label, "__", object, ".", ext))
}
for (f in list.files(out_dir, pattern = paste0("^", skill, "__", p$run_label, "__"), full.names = TRUE)) {
  file.remove(f)
}
# CONVENTIONS.md section 2: every table saved to outputs/ is a tibble,
# including tables one level inside a saved list / result object.
save_rds <- function(x, path) {
  as_tbl <- function(v) if (is.data.frame(v) && !inherits(v, "tbl_df")) tibble::as_tibble(v) else v
  x <- as_tbl(x)
  if (is.list(x) && !is.data.frame(x)) {
    cls <- class(x)
    x[] <- lapply(x, as_tbl)
    class(x) <- cls
  }
  saveRDS(x, path)
}
md5 <- function(f) unname(tools::md5sum(f))
# cairo_pdf renders non-ASCII names and arrows, but on macOS without
# XQuartz it can be reported as available yet write no file: use it only if
# a test file can really be written, otherwise grDevices::pdf.
pdf_device <- local({
  ok <- FALSE
  if (capabilities("cairo")) {
    f <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
    ok <- tryCatch({
      suppressWarnings(grDevices::cairo_pdf(f))
      grDevices::dev.off()
      file.exists(f)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    unlink(f)
  }
  if (ok) grDevices::cairo_pdf else grDevices::pdf
})

has_reactable <- requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)
show_table <- function(df, page_size = 15) {
  if (has_reactable) {
    reactable::reactable(df, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE,
                         defaultPageSize = page_size, striped = TRUE, compact = TRUE)
  } else {
    knitr::kable(df, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

## Run

- Skill: `behavior-endpoints-anova`
- Run label: **`r p$run_label`**
- Similarity metric(s): **`r paste(similarity_metrics, collapse = ", ")`**
- alpha: `r alpha`; RM-ANOVA: `r rmanova_mode`; seed: `r seed`
- zfbehavior version: `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior"))`
- Rendered: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")`

## Upstream

Exactly one `complete` `behavior-endpoints` run, plus optional `complete`
`intraplate-vc-qc` runs made on that same endpoints run, whose
`excluded_plates` are dropped (`CONVENTIONS.md`, section 6).

```{r}
#| label: upstream

read_manifest <- function(run) {
  dir <- file.path(project_root, run)
  f <- list.files(file.path(dir, "outputs"), pattern = "__manifest\\.yml$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) != 1) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints-anova: no unique manifest found in ", file.path(dir, "outputs"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  m <- yaml::read_yaml(f)
  if (!identical(m$status, "complete")) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints-anova: upstream run `", run, "` has status `", m$status,
         "`, not `complete`. Resolve it first (", m$status_reason, ").", call. = FALSE)
  }
  m$.run <- run
  m$.manifest_file <- f
  m
}
check_md5 <- function(m, pattern, what) {
  outs <- data.frame(path = vapply(m$outputs, `[[`, "", "path"),
                     md5 = vapply(m$outputs, `[[`, "", "md5"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rel <- outs$path[grepl(pattern, outs$path)]
  if (length(rel) != 1) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints-anova: upstream manifest of `", m$.run, "` lists no ", what, " output.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  file <- file.path(project_root, m$.run, rel)
  now <- md5(file)
  drift <- !identical(now, outs$md5[outs$path == rel])
  if (drift) {
    warning("Upstream ", what, " md5 differs from its manifest (", m$.run, "): the run was ",
            "modified after it completed. Confirm with the user before using these results.",
            call. = FALSE)
  }
  list(file = file, rel = file.path(m$.run, rel), md5 = now, drift = drift)
}

ups <- lapply(upstream_runs, read_manifest)
up_skills <- vapply(ups, function(m) as.character(m$skill), "")
if (sum(up_skills == "behavior-endpoints") != 1) {
  stop_param("`upstream` must list exactly one behavior-endpoints run.")
}
bad_up <- setdiff(up_skills, c("behavior-endpoints", "intraplate-vc-qc"))
if (length(bad_up) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`upstream` may list only behavior-endpoints and intraplate-vc-qc runs (got ",
                    paste(bad_up, collapse = ", "), ")."))
}
ep <- ups[[which(up_skills == "behavior-endpoints")]]
qc_runs <- ups[up_skills == "intraplate-vc-qc"]
for (m in qc_runs) {
  qc_up <- vapply(m$upstream, function(u) sub("/+$", "", as.character(u$run)), "")
  if (!ep$.run %in% qc_up) {
    stop("behavior-endpoints-anova: QC run `", m$.run, "` was made on ",
         paste(qc_up, collapse = ", "), ", not on the endpoints run `", ep$.run, "`.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}
ep_up_skills <- vapply(ep$upstream, function(u) as.character(u$skill), "")
imp_run <- sub("/+$", "", as.character(ep$upstream[[which(ep_up_skills == "dataset-import-qc")]]$run))
imp <- read_manifest(imp_run)
endpoints_in <- check_md5(ep, "__endpoints\\.rds$", "endpoints.rds")
combined_in <- check_md5(imp, "__combined\\.rds$", "combined.rds")

up_tbl <- data.frame(
  upstream = c(vapply(ups, `[[`, "", ".run"), imp$.run),
  skill = c(up_skills, imp$skill),
  used_for = c(ifelse(up_skills == "behavior-endpoints", "endpoints tested", "plate exclusions"),
               "chemical/plate labels only"),
  status = c(vapply(ups, function(m) as.character(m$status), ""), imp$status),
  # Only intraplate-vc-qc exclusions are applied here; plates excluded before
  # the endpoints run are already absent from its endpoints.
  plates_dropped_here = c(ifelse(up_skills == "intraplate-vc-qc",
                                 as.character(vapply(ups, function(m) length(m$excluded_plates), 1L)), "-"),
                          "-"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(up_tbl, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste0(
  "Upstream runs. endpoints.rds md5 matches its manifest: ", !endpoints_in$drift,
  ". Plates excluded before the endpoints run (already absent): ", length(ep$plates_excluded_by_qc), "."
))
```

```{r}
#| label: load

endpoints <- readRDS(endpoints_in$file)
combined <- readRDS(combined_in$file)

qc_excl <- do.call(rbind, c(
  list(data.frame(plate_id = character(0), reason = character(0), qc_run = character(0))),
  lapply(qc_runs, function(m) {
    if (length(m$excluded_plates) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      plate_id = vapply(m$excluded_plates, function(e) as.character(e$plate_id), ""),
      reason = vapply(m$excluded_plates, function(e) as.character(e$reason), ""),
      qc_run = m$.run, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
))
unknown_excl <- setdiff(qc_excl$plate_id, endpoints$plate_id)
if (length(unknown_excl) > 0) {
  stop("behavior-endpoints-anova: QC-excluded plate(s) not in the endpoints: ",
       paste(unknown_excl, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
d <- endpoints[!endpoints$plate_id %in% qc_excl$plate_id, , drop = FALSE]

label_cols <- unique(c(chemical_label_cols, plate_label_cols))
missing_cols <- setdiff(label_cols, names(combined))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("label column(s) not in the import data: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}
plate_info <- unique(as.data.frame(combined)[combined$plate_id %in% d$plate_id,
                                             unique(c("plate_id", label_cols)), drop = FALSE])
if (anyDuplicated(plate_info$plate_id)) stop_param("label columns are not constant within each plate.")
join_cols <- function(cols) do.call(paste, c(lapply(cols, function(cc) as.character(plate_info[[cc]])), sep = "@"))
plate_info$chemical_label <- join_cols(chemical_label_cols)
plate_info$plate_label <- join_cols(plate_label_cols)
dup_label <- plate_info[duplicated(plate_info[, c("chemical_label", "plate_label")]), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(dup_label) > 0) {
  stop_param("`plate_label_cols` do not identify plates uniquely within a chemical; add plate_id.")
}
plate_info <- plate_info[, c("plate_id", "chemical_label", "plate_label")]

# Endpoint provenance (one row per endpoint label) and segment order of the run.
endpoint_info <- unique(as.data.frame(d)[, c("endpoint", "endpoint_type", "segment", "component", "metric")])
seg_order <- c(names(ep$method$segments), names(ep$method$similarity_segments))
dc_segments <- intersect(names(ep$method$segments),
                         endpoint_info$segment[endpoint_info$endpoint_type == "distance_change_shift" &
                                                 endpoint_info$component %in% "both"])
unknown_ex <- setdiff(activity_exclude_endpoints, endpoint_info$endpoint)
if (length(unknown_ex) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`activity_exclude_endpoints` has endpoint(s) not in the endpoints run: ",
                    paste(unknown_ex, collapse = ", ")))
}
missing_metric <- setdiff(similarity_metrics, endpoint_info$metric)
if (length(missing_metric) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("similarity metric(s) not in the endpoints run: ", paste(missing_metric, collapse = ", "),
                    " (the run has: ", paste(stats::na.omit(unique(endpoint_info$metric)), collapse = ", "), ")."))
}

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  plates_in_endpoints = length(unique(endpoints$plate_id)),
  plates_excluded_by_qc = length(unique(qc_excl$plate_id)),
  plates_tested = length(unique(d$plate_id)),
  distance_change_segments = paste(dc_segments, collapse = ", "),
  similarity_endpoints = paste(endpoint_info$endpoint[endpoint_info$endpoint_type == "movement_similarity" &
                                                        endpoint_info$metric %in% similarity_metrics], collapse = ", ")
), caption = "Data tested.")
if (nrow(qc_excl) > 0) knitr::kable(qc_excl, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Plates excluded by intraplate-vc-qc runs.")
```

## Tests

Historical method (Konrad et al. 2026), on the raw endpoint values
(`endpoint_value_raw`), one model per plate:

- **ANOVA** + Dunnett (each concentration vs vehicle control), per plate x
  endpoint, for distance change (`both`, log10-transformed) per segment and
  for movement similarity per selected metric (Fisher z-transformed).
- **RM-ANOVA** (generalized least squares, AR(1) over segments) + Dunnett,
  per plate, on distance change across all its segments: full model
  (concentration x segment interaction) first, reduced model (concentration
  main effect) as fallback.
- **Hit**: omnibus (or interaction) p < alpha **and** at least one Dunnett
  comparison p < alpha; an undecidable missing p-value gives
  `indeterminate`.

No correction for multiple testing across endpoints or metrics is applied
(as in the historical method): each endpoint/metric is a separate test, so
testing two similarity metrics roughly doubles the chance of a false hit for
movement similarity.

```{r}
#| label: anova

transforms <- c(list(both_auc = "log10"),
                stats::setNames(as.list(rep("fisher_z", length(similarity_metrics))), similarity_metrics))
set.seed(seed)
anova_result <- run_anova(
  d, group_cols = c("plate_id", "endpoint"), value_col = "endpoint_value_raw",
  endpoint_transforms = transforms
)

run_rm <- rmanova_mode == "auto" && length(dc_segments) >= 2
rmanova_note <- if (rmanova_mode == "off") {
  "not run (rmanova: false)"
} else if (!run_rm) {
  paste0("skipped: only ", length(dc_segments), " distance-change segment(s) (needs >= 2)")
} else {
  paste0("run over ", length(dc_segments), " segments: ", paste(dc_segments, collapse = ", "))
}
rmanova_result <- NULL
if (run_rm) {
  set.seed(seed)
  rmanova_result <- run_rmanova(
    d, group_cols = "plate_id", phase_levels = dc_segments, phase_col = "segment",
    value_col = "endpoint_value_raw", endpoint_transforms = list(both_auc = "log10")
  )
}

hits <- run_anova_rmanova_hit_calling(
  anova_result, rmanova_result,
  anova_group_cols = c("plate_id", "endpoint"),
  rmanova_group_cols = if (run_rm) "plate_id" else NULL,
  alpha = alpha
)
hits <- dplyr::left_join(hits, endpoint_info, by = "endpoint")
hits <- dplyr::left_join(hits, plate_info, by = "plate_id")
hits$endpoint[hits$test == "RMANOVA"] <- "distance change (all segments)"
hits <- tibble::as_tibble(hits[, c("plate_id", "chemical_label", "plate_label", "test", "endpoint",
                                   "endpoint_type", "segment", "component", "metric",
                                   setdiff(names(hits), c("plate_id", "chemical_label", "plate_label", "test",
                                                          "endpoint", "endpoint_type", "segment",
                                                          "component", "metric")))])

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  anova_models = nrow(anova_result$anova),
  dunnett_comparisons = nrow(anova_result$dunn),
  rmanova = rmanova_note
), caption = "Models fitted.")
```

## Hits

```{r}
#| label: tbl-hit-counts
#| tbl-cap: "Decisions per test and endpoint (plates)."

hit_counts <- hits |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$test, .data$endpoint) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    plates = dplyr::n(),
    hit = sum(.data$decision_state == "hit"),
    not_hit = sum(.data$decision_state == "not_hit"),
    indeterminate = sum(.data$decision_state == "indeterminate"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
hit_counts <- hit_counts[order(hit_counts$test == "RMANOVA",
                               match(hits$segment[match(hit_counts$endpoint, hits$endpoint)], seg_order)), ]
knitr::kable(hit_counts, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: metric-agreement
#| results: asis

metric_agreement <- NULL
sim_hits <- hits[hits$test == "ANOVA" & hits$endpoint_type %in% "movement_similarity", , drop = FALSE]
if (length(similarity_metrics) >= 2 && nrow(sim_hits) > 0) {
  cat("### Similarity metrics compared\n\n",
      "Per plate and similarity window: hit by which metric(s). Disagreements show where the result ",
      "depends on the metric.\n\n", sep = "")
  wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    sim_hits[, c("plate_id", "segment", "metric", "decision_state")],
    names_from = "metric", values_from = "decision_state"
  )
  wide$hit_by <- apply(wide[, similarity_metrics, drop = FALSE], 1, function(r) {
    h <- similarity_metrics[!is.na(r) & r == "hit"]
    if (length(h) == 0) "none" else if (length(h) == length(similarity_metrics)) "all" else paste(h, collapse = ", ")
  })
  metric_agreement <- dplyr::count(wide, .data$segment, .data$hit_by, name = "plates")
  print(knitr::kable(metric_agreement, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Movement-similarity hits by metric."))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-hits
#| tbl-cap: "All decisions (filter decision_state = hit for the hits). hit_p_value = p-value of the test that decided the hit."

show_cols <- c("chemical_label", "plate_label", "plate_id", "test", "endpoint",
               "decision_state", "decision_source", "hit_p_value", "p_value",
               "p_value_interaction_full", "p_value_conc_unit_reduced",
               "n_posthoc_sig", "n_posthoc_sig_full", "n_posthoc_sig_reduced")
# RM-ANOVA columns exist only when RM-ANOVA was run.
show_hits <- as.data.frame(hits[, intersect(show_cols, names(hits))])
num_cols <- vapply(show_hits, is.double, TRUE)
show_hits[num_cols] <- lapply(show_hits[num_cols], signif, 3)
show_table(show_hits, page_size = 20)
```

```{r}

n_ind <- sum(hits$decision_state == "indeterminate")
if (n_ind > 0) {
  cat("**", n_ind, " indeterminate decision(s)** (a missing p-value prevents a decision); see the ",
```

## Activity plot

`plot_behavior_anova_activity_pages()`: chemicals as facet rows
(`r plot_order`; `r n_per_page` plate rows per page, whole chemicals, pages
padded so a plate row has the same height on every page), plates (the
tested units) as rows within a chemical,
columns = distance change and one movement-similarity column per metric,
x = segments (RM-ANOVA hits at "all phases (RM)"). Point size = p-value
class of the deciding test; only hits are drawn. Left out of this plot:
`r if (length(activity_exclude_tests) + length(activity_exclude_endpoints) == 0) "nothing" else paste(c(activity_exclude_tests, activity_exclude_endpoints), collapse = ", ")`.

```{r}
#| label: activity-pdf
#| results: asis

activity <- hits[, c("plate_id", "chemical_label", "plate_label", "test", "endpoint", "endpoint_type",
                     "segment", "component", "metric", "decision_state", "hit_p_value")]
activity$in_activity_pdf <- !(activity$test %in% activity_exclude_tests |
                                (activity$test == "ANOVA" & activity$endpoint %in% activity_exclude_endpoints))
n_hits_not_in_activity <- sum(activity$decision_state == "hit" & !activity$in_activity_pdf)
if (!all(activity$in_activity_pdf)) {
  left_out <- activity[!activity$in_activity_pdf, , drop = FALSE]
  left_out <- stats::aggregate(list(hits_not_plotted = left_out$decision_state == "hit"),
                               left_out[, c("test", "endpoint")], sum)
  print(knitr::kable(left_out, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste0(
    "Results left out of the activity PDF (reason: ", activity_exclude_reason,
    "). They stay in hits.rds and activity.rds (in_activity_pdf = FALSE).")))
}
plot_rows <- activity[activity$in_activity_pdf, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(plot_rows) == 0) stop_param("the activity exclusions leave nothing to plot.")
pages <- plot_behavior_anova_activity_pages(
  plot_rows, chemical_col = "chemical_label", plate_label_col = "plate_label",
  segment_levels = seg_order, order = plot_order, n_per_page = n_per_page,
  page_height = pdf_height, chemical_wrap_width = chemical_wrap_width
)
label_fit <- attr(pages, "label_fit")
n_label_overflow <- sum(!label_fit$fits)
activity_pdf <- out_path("activity", "pdf")
dev_fun <- pdf_device
dev_fun(activity_pdf, width = pdf_width, height = pdf_height, onefile = TRUE)
for (pg in pages) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(pg)
}
invisible(grDevices::dev.off())

print(knitr::kable(data.frame(pdf = activity_pdf, pages = length(pages),
                              chemicals = length(unique(plot_rows$chemical_label)),
                              plate_rows_per_page = paste(attr(pages, "page_plate_rows"), collapse = ", "),
                              labels_not_fitting = n_label_overflow),
                   caption = "Activity PDF written."))
if (n_label_overflow > 0) {
  warning(n_label_overflow, " chemical label(s) are taller than their panel at pdf_height = ", pdf_height,
          " in: increase `pdf_height` or `chemical_wrap_width` (see the table below).", call. = FALSE)
  print(knitr::kable(as.data.frame(label_fit[!label_fit$fits, ]), row.names = FALSE,
                     caption = "Chemical labels that do not fit their panel."))
}
```

## Status and outputs

```{r}
#| label: save

status <- "complete"
n_hit_plates <- length(unique(hits$plate_id[hits$decision_state == "hit"]))
status_reason <- paste0(length(unique(hits$plate_id)), " plate(s) tested; ",
                        sum(hits$decision_state == "hit"), " hit(s) on ", n_hit_plates, " plate(s); ",
                        sum(hits$decision_state == "indeterminate"), " indeterminate. Inspect the activity PDF.")

save_rds(anova_result, out_path("anova", "rds"))
outputs <- out_path("anova", "rds")
if (run_rm) {
  save_rds(rmanova_result, out_path("rmanova", "rds"))
  outputs <- c(outputs, out_path("rmanova", "rds"))
}
save_rds(hits, out_path("hits", "rds"))
save_rds(activity, out_path("activity", "rds"))
outputs <- c(outputs, out_path("hits", "rds"), out_path("activity", "rds"), activity_pdf)

count_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(hit_counts)), function(i) as.list(hit_counts[i, ]))
manifest <- list(
  skill = skill,
  run_label = p$run_label,
  status = status,
  status_reason = status_reason,
  rendered_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
  zfbehavior_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior")),
  upstream = lapply(ups, function(m) list(
    run = m$.run, skill = m$skill,
    manifest = file.path(m$.run, "outputs", basename(m$.manifest_file)), status = m$status
  )),
  import_run = imp$.run,
  inputs = list(
    list(path = endpoints_in$rel, md5 = endpoints_in$md5, md5_matches_upstream_manifest = !endpoints_in$drift),
    list(path = combined_in$rel, md5 = combined_in$md5, md5_matches_upstream_manifest = !combined_in$drift)
  ),
  outputs = lapply(outputs, function(f) list(path = f, md5 = md5(f))),
  method = list(
    value = "endpoint_value_raw",
    anova = "per plate x endpoint; aov + DescTools::DunnettTest vs vehicle control",
    transforms = transforms,
    similarity_metrics = similarity_metrics,
    rmanova = rmanova_note,
    rmanova_segments = if (run_rm) dc_segments else list(),
    alpha = alpha,
    seed = seed,
    multiple_testing_correction = "none across endpoints/metrics (historical method)",
    activity_exclude_tests = as.list(activity_exclude_tests),
    activity_exclude_endpoints = as.list(activity_exclude_endpoints),
    activity_exclude_reason = activity_exclude_reason
  ),
  plates_excluded_by_qc = lapply(seq_len(nrow(qc_excl)), function(i) as.list(qc_excl[i, ])),
  summary = list(
    n_plates = length(unique(hits$plate_id)),
    n_hits = sum(hits$decision_state == "hit"),
    n_hit_plates = n_hit_plates,
    n_indeterminate = sum(hits$decision_state == "indeterminate"),
    n_pdf_pages = length(pages),
    n_labels_not_fitting = n_label_overflow,
    n_hits_not_in_activity = n_hits_not_in_activity,
    counts = count_list
  ),
  parameters = p
)
yaml::write_yaml(manifest, out_path("manifest", "yml"))
```

**Status: `r status`.** `r status_reason`

```{r}
             caption = "Files written by this run.")
```
